data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate also benefitted from prior year releases of $4,102.6k (2013: $5,166.1k). The prior year benefitted from exceptional reserve releases from loss reserves held in relation to the 2011 and 2012 underwriting years. This decrease in prior year releases represents the key driver of the increased claims ratio.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reserve releases relating to underwriting year 2012

named_events.loss_description: Despite the impact of superstorm Sandy in October 2012, the 2012 underwriting year declares a profit.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were $25.076m. The syndicate recorded prior year releases of $4.103m (reported in the managing agent commentary), driven by exceptional reserve releases related to the 2011 and 2012 underwriting years, resulting in a net favourable prior year development (a release) of approximately 16.4% of opening claims reserves. The business is predominately property reinsurance, and these releases supported the reported underwriting performance.
raw_causal_phrases: exceptional reserve releases from loss reserves held in relation to the 2011 and 2012 underwriting years.
This decrease in prior year releases represents the key driver of the increased claims ratio.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: All risks were underwritten in the UK and relate to property reinsurance business.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement ('movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' by insurance liabilities) was presented. The report gives a prior year release amount ($4,102.6k) in the managing agent narrative but does not label it gross vs net; this extraction used that explicit narrative figure as a net fallback (NET of reinsurance possibly). Opening reserves were taken from the balance sheet prior-year comparative (2013) claims outstanding. All source amounts in the report are presented in $'000; values here are converted to millions (divide by 1,000). Confidence for prior-year movement is reduced because the gross (insurance liabilities) movement figure was not available.
